description: FAST TRACK Provision of semi basement pool building under section of the rear garden.
decision_conditions:
<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿<u>Flood Risk -</u>&nbsp;The development shall comply with the recommendations set out in the&nbsp;</span>Flood Risk Assessment and Sustainable Drainage Strategy (Ref: 22268/FRASDS_Rev1.0) and shall be permanently retained thereafter unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</p><p><span style="line-height: 107%;"></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure satisfactory means of&nbsp; water
drainage, to reduce the risk of flooding and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021 and
policies F15.7, F15.8 and F15.9 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
" arial",sans-serif"=""><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Tree Protection</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> -&nbsp;</span></span></span>The details and measures for the protection of the
existing trees as specified in the hereby approved document ‘BS 5837:2012 Tree
Survey, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Tree Constraints Plan, Arboricultural
Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan’ dated February 2026' shall be
fully complied with. The methods for the protection of the existing trees shall
fully accord with all of the measures specified in the report and shall be
installed prior to the commencement of any site works and shall remain in place
until the conclusion of all site works﻿.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason:</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp; </span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">To protect
and safeguard the existing retained trees in accordance with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policy G7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies
O15.1, O15.2 and O15.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></p>
